title: PRIVATE VENDETTA // CONTRACT ON HITMAN ZERO
issued_by: Associates of Courier Alexei (The Zurich Blind Trust Creditors)
body: NOTICE OF ESCALATED BLOOD DEBT: Associates of Fixer Raymond (The Kowloon Triad Union) has increased the private bounty on operative Hitman Zero (+25000 CHF) following repeated reckless violence against Fixer Raymond in Berlin. The Sedes Obscura Grand Chancellery remains neutral, but private escrow has been verified.
